statement: Candidate2 current-source focused release suite passes49 tests. New checks compare fused canonical131-bit products with independent bitwise reduction on all17161 basis pairs, and prove cache separation for the distinct NIST131 polynomial while sharing only complete identical polynomials. Existing53248 raw-limb basis products, parser-grammar/boundary tests, context/projector and compact field/group tests also pass. Producer-written checks, unsigned; no candidate2 performance claim.
